jobs.description:
EngRadar / Element Biosciences

Director, Software Engineering

Element Biosciences

Element Biosciences empowers the scientific community with more freedom and flexibility to accelerate our collective impact on humanity through next-generation life science products.

Element Biosciences
is the employer — EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs.

At Element Biosciences, we are passionate about our mission to empower the scientific community with more freedom and flexibility to accelerate our collective impact on humanity. We have built a highly efficient product-driven organization where employees can learn, grow, and thrive in a challenging but encouraging environment. We are committed to scientific integrity, collegiality, honesty, objectivity, and openness.

We're hiring a Director of Software Engineering
to lead a team of developers building the software that powers our multi-omic instruments and platforms. Your team's surface area spans frontend, backend, cloud services, instrument software, CLI/API, and agentic tooling -- across customer-facing products and internal tools that keep the rest of the organization moving fast. This is a hands-on Director role. You'll spend roughly 60% of your time as an IC -- writing production-grade code, driving architecture, and running design reviews -- and 40% managing, mentoring, and growing your team. You'll set direction across the full stack, own delivery for your team's products, and act as the connective tissue between product, chemistry, hardware, and adjacent software teams. Our software supports both research and regulated markets, so you'll need to move fast where you can and hold the line on design controls and V&V where it matters.

We're an AI-forward org. Our engineers use Cursor, Claude, and other AI tooling daily, and we're actively rolling out agentic SDLC workflows across the software function. You'll be expected to champion and shape that adoption for your team. You are a senior technical leader who has shipped production-grade software across the full stack, is comfortable getting hands-on in any layer, and has a track record of building and growing high-performing engineering teams. You bring grit, a bias for action, and a can-do attitude when things get hard. This role will report to our VP, Software and will be a daily onsite role in San Diego, CA.

If you possess the following and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to explore this role.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software developers spanning frontend, backend, cloud, and instrument software
Set technical direction, define priorities, and align team execution with company goals and product roadmaps
Own hiring, 1:1s, performance reviews, career development, and resourcing decisions for the team
Foster a culture of ownership, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Manage team budget, capacity planning, and cross-team dependencies; partner with peer leaders across Informatics, AI, Product, Hardware, and Chemistry
Champion and roll out agentic SDLC practices -- Cursor, Claude, and AI-driven workflows -- across your team, into the broader software org, and help shape best practices for the larger company
Contribute to overall software processes, practices, training, and quality/security assurances for the software department
Contribute hands-on across the stack: frontend (React), backend (Go), cloud services (AWS), workflow orchestration (Temporal), instrument software (Ubuntu), and CLI/API, and agentic tooling
Drive architecture and design for customer-facing products and internal tooling; run design reviews and set the bar for production-grade code, testing, and observability
Own end-to-end delivery for one or more product areas -- from requirements through deployment and sustaining
Partner with product owners, chemistry, hardware, and adjacent software teams to translate multi-omic workflows into scalable, performant software
Debug hard cross-system issues, root-cause complex bugs, and jump in on customer-blocking problems when needed
Prototype quickly with AI tools to validate ideas, pressure-test specs, and de-risk approaches before they reach the team
Advocate for the engineering systems, tools, and workflows that accelerate long-term product velocity
Support both research-market and regulated software development within your team's scope
Own or oversee design controls, verification and validation documentation, risk analysis, and traceability for regulated products (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, IVDR, FDA 21 CFR Part 820)
Partner with regulatory affairs and QMS teams to support audits, inspections, and submissions

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Bioengineering, or related field (advanced degree preferred)
10+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years directly managing engineering teams
Track record shipping production-grade software across the full stack -- frontend, backend, cloud services, and workflow orchestration
Hands-on fluency with our stack or close equivalents: Go, React, MongoDB, Redis, gRPC, GraphQL, Temporal, Ubuntu, AWS
Daily fluency with AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude, or similar) and demonstrated experience introducing or scaling agentic SDLC workflows within a team
Experience shipping software that spans instrumentation, cloud SaaS, and CLI/API tooling
Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills; comfortable presenting to executives, customers, and technical stakeholders
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while balancing IC contribution and team leadership
Experience with life sciences, multi-omic, DNA sequencing, or scientific instrumentation software
Experience with regulated software workflows -- IEC 62304, ISO 13485, IVDR, or FDA 21 CFR Part 820 -- including design controls, traceability, and V&V documentation for SaMD or instrument software
Experience shipping ML/AI features -- traditional ML pipelines and/or LLM/agent-based features (RAG, tool use, evals)
Cross-organizational or inter-company collaboration experience

Physical Requirements

Must be flexible in working hours as this position may require customer support during non-regular business hours

Location:

San Diego – on-site

$180,000 - $254,000

In addition to base compensation noted above, you will be eligible for stock options, discretionary annual bonus, no cost health insurance plans, 401k with company match, and flexible paid time off.

Please note: Base compensation will depend on multiple factors, including geographic location, qualifications, and experience.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Embark on a career putting innovative, reliable, and agile products and ideas into orbit, and beyond. Northrop Grumman has opportunities waiting for you that play a vital role in human space exploration, national defense, and scientific discovery, supporting multiple programs across the universe. With us, you’ll discover a culture of curiosity and collaboration that will have you Defining Possible from the day you start. Our space systems connect and protect millions of people on earth every day, now and for the future. Explore your future and launch your career today.

Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems sector is looking for a Director 1, Test Engineering
in our SDS Division. This leadership role is located in Roy, UT
. Northrop Grumman supports the Air Force’s Sentinel, sustainment, development, production and deployment of hardware and system modifications for Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Ground and Airborne Launch Control Systems, Launch Facilities and associated infrastructure.

The Test Engineering Functional Homeroom is responsible for development, career growth, and leadership of a multi-disciplined test engineering team as well as test process and governance, training content development, KPI metrics, and organizational infrastructure of the Test Directorate. This team is also responsible for enabling execution of test planning, test execution, and test reporting to include lab, ground, and flight testing; lab design and operations; test data and instrumentation, system integration, and verification testing in support of Integrated Functional Capability to support successful program execution. Testing occurs at Northrop Grumman, various supplier, and US Government facilities throughout the US.

As a senior leader, you act with integrity and the highest ethical standards in everything you do. You enable your team to achieve predictable and balanced results, while satisfying the needs of internal and external partners. You treat all people with respect, and you model personal growth and continuous development. You know how to build an inclusive environment that attracts, retains, and inspires a diverse and engaged team. You develop trusted and valued customer relationships and communicate effectively, so that personnel throughout the organization are engaged, motivated, and connected to their work. You deliver excellence, strive for continuous improvement, and respond vigorously to change.

Lead a high-performing test engineering team in test planning, integration, and execution across the SDS Division portfolio of programs while reporting directly to the SDS Vice President of Engineering.

Develop and foster Test Engineering vision aligned to overall division engineering vision of world-class engineering.
Develop and drive progress of Test Engineering goals and milestones.

Lead a large team of cross discipline directors, managers, and professionals at various locations responsible for Test Engineering support of a portfolio of mission critical programs across all phases of EMD test (lab, ground, and flight) including instrumentation and test data collection.
Responsible for establishing and directing the implementation of test engineering process and governance driving consistency across program/product teams at all locations and multiple subcontractor locations.
Responsible for establishing and implementing test tools and automation to drive standardization and efficiency across the directorate.
Responsible for developing training to ensure test teams are trained and capable of test execution.
Participate in establishing and directing the implementation of model-based digital engineering processes used in the design and development of Test Engineering execution and test lab design at all levels of decomposition.
Ensure test engineering first time quality of products, manage auditing, and oversight functions including metrics development and management.
Interface closely with the product/program team leadership and implement test engineering priorities

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Software Engineering, Digital for Research & CMC Development
jobs.description:
The Role

We are seeking a Senior Director of Software Engineering to lead the software engineering organization supporting Research and CMC Development. Reporting to the Head of Digital for Research and CMC Development (D4RT), this leader will establish clear engineering standards and operating rhythms, drive accountability and predictable execution, and build a high-performing organization capable of delivering reliable, scalable digital solutions that advance scientific research and development.

This leader will oversee full-stack application and integration engineering capabilities, leading and developing engineering leaders and senior technical contributors while strengthening engineering practices across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering experience with strong operational and people leadership. They bring the technical credibility to effectively lead senior engineers, evaluate system-level tradeoffs, and develop exceptional technical talent. While this is not a hands-on development role, this leader will bring strong systems thinking, understand the broader implications of technical decisions, and empower technical leads and other senior contributors to provide technical leadership across the organization.

The successful candidate will also have significant experience within biotechnology or biopharmaceutical organizations and a strong understanding of scientific Research and CMC Development environments. They will understand the scientific context, workflows, ways of working, and cross-functional dynamics required to translate complex scientific needs into effective digital and software strategies.

Here’s What You’ll Do

Software Engineering Operations

Lead the evolution of the software engineering organization, establishing the leadership practices, operating model, engineering standards, and talent capabilities needed to support a growing Research and CMC Development digital portfolio.
Build and develop strong engineering leaders and senior technical contributors, enabling them to grow talent, delegate effectively, establish clear ownership, and operate at the right level of technical and organizational leadership.
Establish clear and consistent expectations for performance and career progression across the engineering organization, creating transparency around what strong performance looks like and how individuals grow in scope and impact.
Establish effective engineering operating rhythms and portfolio management practices that provide visibility into priorities, capacity, resource allocation, commitments, delivery health, dependencies, and risks, enabling informed tradeoffs when demand exceeds capacity.
Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and ownership in which teams deliver against commitments, leaders address systemic barriers to delivery and meaningful improvements to engineering practices and ways of working.

Application & Integration Engineering

Provide senior oversight across custom full-stack application and integration engineering capacities supporting scientific and operational workflows.
Guide engineering strategy across commercial SaaS platforms, custom applications, scientific systems, enterprise platforms, and data products, promoting reusable APIs, services, integration patterns, and shared capabilities.
Drive simplification and sustainability across the technology landscape, ensuring applications and integrations leverage sound cloud architecture and engineering practices and are designed with reliability, observability, security, scalability, and operational support appropriate to their use.

Partner with Product Management

Partner with Product Management to maintain alignment across product priorities, planned initiatives, engineering capacity, and existing commitments, enabling effective resource planning and informed portfolio tradeoffs.
Bring an engineering and systems perspective into product planning, helping teams understand how proposed solutions fit within the broader digital ecosystem and when software engineering capabilities are needed.
Develop engineering leaders who can partner effectively with Product leads, while working across D4RT leadership to strengthen Product–Engineering ways of working, shared planning, and decision-making.

Partner Across Digital

Build strong partnerships across Digital, including Data Engineering, DevOps and Cybersecurity to navigate shared priorities and dependencies and effectively leverage enterprise platforms, data products, standards, and expertise.
Bring an informed engineering perspective to cross-Digital initiatives and enterprise technology decisions, understanding their implications for Research and CMC Development and constructively influencing approaches where needed.

Drive Scientific & Operational Impact

Build trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders across Research and CMC Development, developing a deep understanding of scientific workflows, development processes, data flows, and decision-making needs to inform engineering strategy and priorities.
Translate complex and sometimes ambiguous scientific needs into pragmatic, scalable digital solutions that improve scientific and operational outcomes.

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications)

15+ years of progressive software engineering and technology experience, including 10+ years of engineering leadership experience with responsibility for engineering teams, leaders, and senior technical contributors.
10+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant hands-on experience designing and delivering production software, with strong technical depth across modern software architecture, cloud-native engineering, full-stack development, APIs, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
5+ years of modern cloud architecture and cloud-native engineering principles, with experience evaluate architectural approaches and tradeoffs across complex software environments.
10+ years of leadership experience within biotechnology or biopharmaceutical organizations, with direct experience supporting scientific Research, CMC Development, Technical Development, Process Development, or closely related R&D functions.
Demonstrated experience leading and scaling software engineering organizations, including developing engineering leaders and senior technical talent, evolving engineering operating models and practices, and driving strong organizational performance.

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

Experience with scientific and laboratory technology ecosystems, including ELN, LIMS, SDMS, laboratory automation, scientific data platforms, modeling or analytical systems, or related capabilities.
Experience integrating commercial scientific SaaS platforms within complex biotechnology or biopharmaceutical technology environments.
Experience applying AI-enabled engineering tools and practices to improve software development productivity, quality, and scalability, with the technical fluency to guide engineering teams on effective and responsible adoption.

Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work.
That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown

An individual’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, and business or organizational needs. jobs.title: VP AI Technology, Innovation & Delivery
jobs.description:
Regenerons Enterprise Data & AI organization is newly established and moving fast built to drive AI transformation and adoption at scale across every part of the enterprise. This is a high-visibility, high-velocity position where the work is directly tied to business and scientific impact.

The Vice President, AI Technology, Innovation and Delivery is the first hire into this function. This leader establishes Regeneron's AI architecture foundation, stands up the engineering capability, and builds the practice before leading it. Accountable for translating frontier AI capabilities into production-grade solutions, this role defines the enterprise AI architecture vision, stands up Forward Deployment Engineering, and owns the AI innovation engine from horizon scanning to proof-of-concept to scaled deployment. As the organization matures, this leader will lay the groundwork for future sub-function leaders across architecture, engineering, and innovation.

The role works in close partnership with the Data & AI Engineering leader in Regenerons Global Capability Center (GCC) in India, where build and operate resides. Together, they ensure that what is designed is architected for platform-scale delivery and built to last.

This position reports to the SVP Chief AI Officer.

Core Responsibilities

Agentic AI Strategy & Platform Evaluation

Defines and owns the enterprise AI architecture vision, design patterns, and technical standards across Regeneron. Sets enterprise direction for agentic AI, evaluating and selecting platforms, frameworks, and architecture patterns. Strategy and platform selection reside in this role; build and operate sit within the GCC.
Determines where Regeneron builds, buys, or partners for agentic AI capabilities, ensuring strategic alignment with the GCC for build-and-operate execution.
Translates business problems into solution blueprints, architecture patterns, and integration pathways, owning design decisions from concept through prototype with production-grade rigor.

Enterprise AI Product Management

Leads a team of product managers and product owners accountable for Regenerons portfolio of enterprise AI capabilities. Each capability has a defined owner, a roadmap, and adoption metrics, ensuring AI solutions are treated as products, not projects: with clear business sponsors, measurable outcomes, and a path to sustained value.

Emerging Technology & Industry Intelligence

Tracks the AI frontier across models, platforms, agentic frameworks, and methods, and translates that intelligence into concrete recommendations tied to Regenerons business and scientific priorities.
Maintains a clear view of how AI is advancing across biopharma and life sciences and identifies where emerging capabilities can solve real problems or unlock new opportunities. Runs structured pilots with clear adoption criteria.

Forward Deployment Engineering

Stands up Regenerons Forward Deployment Engineering capability from the ground up. Deploys cross-domain squads that embed directly with business and scientific stakeholders to accelerate priority use cases. Operates in two modes: rapid deployment of configured GenAI and low-code/no-code solutions and structured prototype-to-handoff engagements for higher-complexity problems requiring GCC production engineering.
Defines the squad model, deployment playbook, and engagement standards, establishing the operational distinction between rapid-deployment and build-to-scale modes from day one.

People & Organizational Leadership

Builds, develops, and leads a multidisciplinary organization spanning product managers, applied AI engineers, solutions architects, and forward deployment engineers. Sets the technical bar, develops senior talent, and holds the organization to measurable outcomes.
Partners with GCC engineering leadership to ensure solutions are buildable, scalable, and maintainable at platform level. Defines and governs handoff standards between applied AI prototypes and GCC production engineering.
Represents applied AI to senior leadership across the enterprise. Partners with peers across Enterprise Data & AI to ensure delivery is integrated with data, MLOps, and governance functions.

Qualifications

BS/BA degree in a related field required.
20+ years leading applied AI/ML organizations through the full lifecycle opportunity identification, architecture, prototype, and production handoff.
Demonstrated experience building and leading AI product management organizations establishing product ownership, roadmaps, and adoption accountability for enterprise AI capabilities.
Strong product mindset paired with hands-on solution architecture depth; able to operate as both strategist and technical leader not a pure people-manager.

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Center Design Manager to lead and manage the design process on behalf of CoreWeave, overseeing the design of our Data Center Fit Outs (White Space) and ensuring that designs meet and incorporate CoreWeave project requirements.

About The Role

This role will primarily focus on managing the execution of Architectural, MEP, and LV/IT infrastructure designs within our leased data center facilities. The Design Manager will ensure that all designs align with our project requirements and are executed to meet performance, efficiency, and scalability standards. The role will also provide ongoing support into the Fit Out construction phase to ensure the design is implemented accurately. Acting as the primary point of contact for design-related matters, on a per-project basis, this individual will collaborate with internal teams and external consultants to ensure designs are executed consistently and to the highest quality standards.

Up to 30% travel required to various data center sites.

Who You Are

Project Leadership & Oversight: Manage the design and coordination of multiple data center fit out projects concurrently. Oversee the work of Professional Consultants (Architects, Engineers) and Equipment Suppliers during the design process.
Single Point of Contact for Design on Assigned Projects: Act as the primary point of contact for all design-related items for assigned projects, coordinating closely with Data Center Providers and their Contractors, Architects/Engineers (A/E firms), along with our internal stakeholders to ensure seamless communication and alignment throughout the design process.
Internal Coordination with SMEs: Coordinate with internal Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across various disciplines, including electrical, mechanical, and LV/IT, to ensure project requirements, technical specifications, and solutions are properly aligned, integrating specialized expertise into the design process as needed.
Standards & Compliance: Apply CoreWeave Design & Engineering Guidelines and industry best practices to ensure alignment with company objectives and emphasize value-engineering for optimal cost and performance.
Managing Basis of Design Deviations: Track and document any deviations from the Basis of Design throughout the project lifecycle, coordinating with internal teams and external consultants.
Budget & Schedule Coordination: Work with the Technical Project Management team to prepare, review, and monitor project schedules, budgets, and forecasts for design and construction expenditures.
OFCI Equipment Management: Review and evaluate OFCI (Owner-Furnished, Contractor-Installed) equipment submittals, providing recommendations to the Construction Management team and Procurement teams.
Design Reviews: Participate in page-turn meetings with consultants, providing feedback on designs, Sequence of Operations, Basis of Design documents, commissioning plans, and testing scripts.
Vendor Management: Assist with RFPs for A/E consultants, evaluation of proposals, selection of vendors, and oversight on alignment with project budgets and schedules, while reviewing/approving consultant invoices.
Executive & Project Reporting: Prepare and deliver detailed project reports to both executive leadership and project teams, track project budgets, schedules, scope objectives, and progress, ensuring alignment with CoreWeave’s gating process and smooth handoff to the Construction Management team for ongoing management.
Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular project updates to internal and external stakeholders, both informally and formally.
Design Coordination & Site Visits: Conduct site visits during construction to review design implementation, assess construction progress, and ensure adherence to design specifications, quality standards, and project requirements.
Collaboration Across Teams: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Capacity, Network Engineering, Construction, Operations, Supply Chain and Technical Project Management to ensure alignment with business objectives and project deliverables. Serve as a liaison between internal teams and external consultants or vendors, ensuring clear and effective communication.
Innovation & Design Enhancement: Contribute to internal design team meetings, proposing and exploring new technologies or design concepts to enhance project outcomes. Stay up to date with industry trends and integrate innovative solutions into project designs.

Required Skills

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Network, Low Voltage/Cabling or related field), Architecture, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in data center engineering or design with a proven track record of successfully completing data center design projects.
Strong knowledge of data center white space, including cooling systems, power distribution, network architecture, and LV/IT design.
Experience with large-scale, high-density data centers and cloud infrastructure, including familiarity with power, cooling, and other critical infrastructure systems.
Proven ability to manage complex projects with strong project management and organizational skills, ensuring successful project delivery on time and within budget.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining a high level of attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on developing efficient, cost-effective solutions to complex design challenges.
Professional certifications (e.g., Uptime Institute, BICSI, LEED, or similar) are a plus.

We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who can bring their diverse experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.
Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

You’re an expert in managing complex projects with strong project management and organizational skills.

Why CoreWeave?

About

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About The Team

The Technical Support Engineering - Infrastructure team sits within CoreWeave's Global Field Organization (GFO) and is the front line for every customer running AI and HPC workloads on our platform. Operating 24/7/365, the team supports the Kubernetes-powered infrastructure behind the AI revolution: GPU compute, high-performance networking and storage, Slurm/HPC clusters, and the large-scale, mission-critical training workloads that run on them.

We operate on a Direct-to-Expert
model. Instead of routing customers through generic support tiers, we get the right expert on the problem fast while a single owner stays accountable for the issue end-to-end. That means fewer handoffs, clearer ownership, and a high-touch experience that our customers feel on every ticket. The team is the connective tissue between our customers and CoreWeave's engineering organization. We triage and resolve deep technical issues directly, coordinate with Product Engineering, Specialist Field Engineers, and domain specialists when needed, and feed what we learn in the field straight back into the product roadmap.

About The Role

As the Senior Manager of Technical Support Engineering - Infrastructure, you'll own, scale, and continuously improve CoreWeave's infrastructure support function — a large, globally distributed 24/7/365 organization of skilled engineers who resolve our customers' most complex technical challenges with deep expertise, efficiency, and empathy. High-touch, expert-led support is one of CoreWeave's clearest differentiators, which gives this role prominent visibility and influence across the company.

You'll operate at the department level, setting the technical and operational bar for the entire function and designing the operating systems (coverage/staffing model, Direct-to-Expert
partnerships, quality program, metrics) that let support scale reliably. You'll lead with empathy and invest in each person's growth, while building the structure and processes that let the team scale with CoreWeave's hyper-growth without compromising the culture we care deeply about.

In This Role, You Will

Own the strategy, health, and performance of the entire 24/7/365 infrastructure support function, helping scale coverage and capability across regions and domains as CoreWeave grows.
Own talent acquisition and retention by hiring, onboarding, and developing engineers through diligent performance management and coaching tailored to each individual's needs.
Stay hands-on: dig into complex, customer-impacting issues alongside your team and serve as a senior technical escalation point, ensuring the highest quality of support.
Build and facilitate the enablement and career-development frameworks for onboarding, technical training, and progression paths that raise capability across the whole function and create a repeatable path for career growth.
Implement quality assurance measures, including ticket reviews and best-practice playbooks, that raise the bar on resolution speed, accuracy, and consistency.
Own the support operating model for the function including roles and responsibilities, escalation boundaries, coverage/staffing model, and the response and resolution targets (SLOs) that keep every customer's experience consistently excellent as volume scales.
Lead customer communication during critical incidents and resolve conflicts with clarity, composure, and empathy.
Track and report on KPIs focused on team performance and customer satisfaction, and own the strategic planning for the team's growth and scalability.
Own the cross-functional interface between support and Product Engineering, Specialist Field Engineers, and domain teams, building the alignment mechanisms and feedback loops that make the Direct-to-Expert model work at scale for escalations, live incidents, and customer needs.
Champion the voice of the customer, turning recurring support patterns into product, tooling, and process improvements.
Help set the multi-quarter vision and operating plan for infrastructure support, and represent the function in company-level planning, headcount, and prioritization discussions.

Who You Are

You have 5+ years of people-leadership experience and 8+ years total in technical support/operations, including running a 24/7 support function at scale in a cloud operations environment.
You have a strong background in Linux, containerization technologies, and Kubernetes, and you understand virtualization and cloud computing concepts. Experience at a hyperscaler or cloud infrastructure provider is a strong plus.
You lead with empathy and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty. You do the work alongside your direct reports and model the standard you set.
You're energized by leadership excellence and talent development: diligent performance management, coaching, and growing each engineer according to their individual needs.
You've built enablement and quality programs that scaled across a function or multiple teams — and can show the measurable improvement they drove.
You've designed the operating model for a support org, including coverage/staffing model, escalation boundaries, SLOs, and evolved it as the org scaled.
You're a calm, clear communicator with customers and executives during critical incidents, and you resolve conflicts effectively across teams and organizational boundaries.
You think in systems and multi-quarter plans. You've defined KPI/SLO frameworks, reported to senior leadership, and owned capacity and growth planning for a function, not just a single team.
You've led a globally distributed team across time zones.
Leadership & Communication: proven ability to lead through senior talent and set direction for a function, with executive-level communication skills.
Strategic & Operational Planning: you build operating systems, plans, and metrics that scale a function beyond what any one person can hold.
Problem-Solving & Adaptability: robust problem-solving skills and adaptability at organizational scale, in a fast-paced, hyper-growth environment.
Program Management: experience with program-management tools and methodologies.

Bonus Points If You Have

Experience supporting AI/ML, HPC, or GPU-accelerated workloads at scale.
Hands-on Kubernetes operations experience (CKA certification a plus).
Familiarity with Slurm/SUNK, RDMA networking, distributed storage, and observability tooling such as Grafana.
You have some experience with infrastructure as it relates to Data Center Operations.

Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.
